note: What a server sends to set a unit moving along a path at a speed of its own, perhaps in an arc or following another unit. The header names the unit. A client answers every one at once, as it answers Path, whatever its sync id. It applies it only where the sync id is not older than the last the unit took (as UnitStopped).

fields.name: syncId
fields.note: The unit's movement count.

fields.name: speed
fields.note: The speed to move at, in world units a second.

fields.name: gravity
fields.note: The arc's gravity, for a leap, in units of 150 world units a second squared. Zero or less moves the unit flat.

fields.name: arcX
fields.note: Where the arc begins, in world units.

fields.name: arcZ
fields.note: Where the arc begins, in world units.

fields.name: facing
fields.note: Which way the unit faces as it moves.

fields.name: follow
fields.note: A unit to follow, or zero for none.

fields.name: followDistance
fields.note: How near to keep to it, in world units. It takes effect only where follow is not zero.

fields.name: backOff
fields.note: How far to fall back from it, in world units. It takes effect only where follow is not zero.

fields.name: travelTime
fields.note: How long the move takes, in seconds. It takes effect only where follow is not zero.

fields.name: points
x
fields.note: A point on the path, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: A point on the path, in world units.
The path's points, to the end of the message. A client takes the ground's height for each.
